title: Social Media
summary: Online communities were a feature of the pre-Web internet, and Friendster, MySpace and others brought them to the Web. Facebook, launched in 2004 as a private network for US college students, came late but reached critical mass: its millionth user registered on 30 December 2004, it passed 500 million users by 2010 and 1 billion by 2012. In the United States, Pew found that 65 percent of adults used social networking sites in 2015, up from 7 percent in 2005.

uncertainty.note: 2004 marked the founding of Facebook and the widespread recognition of Web 2.0 social networking, building on earlier platforms such as Friendster and MySpace.
